; Resolve the current lasso, capture it after the popout closes, then detach the
; subscription request and guarded native writer from Xochitl's transient scene.
AFFECT [[11806562588218124596]]

	IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor [[180922.180921]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[18399528329672988301]]

	INSERT {

	property var paperAgentCachedSelectionBounds: null

	function paperAgentCopyBounds(bounds) {
		if (!bounds || !isFinite(bounds.x) || !isFinite(bounds.y)
				|| !isFinite(bounds.width) || !isFinite(bounds.height)
				|| Number(bounds.width) <= 0 || Number(bounds.height) <= 0)
			return null

				~&8399340108982949229&~.~&15752433948179392809&~,

			if (~&8399340108982949229&~["getItemBoundingRect"])
				bounds = ~&8399340108982949229&~["getItemBoundingRect"](items)
		} catch (error) {

	function paperAgentRefreshSelectionBounds() {
		var bounds = paperAgentLookupSelectionBounds(false)
		if (!bounds) return
		paperAgentCachedSelectionBounds = bounds
		paperAgentCachedSelectionAt = (new Date()).getTime()
	}

	Timer {
		interval: 200
		repeat: true
		running: true
		onTriggered: paperAgentRefreshSelectionBounds()

	function paperAgentBestSelectionBounds() {
		var bounds = paperAgentLookupSelectionBounds(true)
		if (bounds) {
			paperAgentCachedSelectionBounds = bounds
			paperAgentCachedSelectionAt = (new Date()).getTime()
			return bounds
		}
		var age = (new Date()).getTime() - paperAgentCachedSelectionAt
		if (paperAgentCachedSelectionBounds && age >= 0 && age <= 1500) {
			console.log("paper-agent using cached selection", "age=" + age)
			return paperAgentCachedSelectionBounds
		}
		return null
	}

	function paperAgentCropForSelection(bounds) {

		// On Chiappa, getItemBoundingRect() is already expressed at framebuffer
		// scale: Y is top-origin and X is centre-origin. sceneToView() applies the
		// notebook zoom a second time, which moves a correct selection down/right.
		// Translate only the centred X axis into rm-shot's top-left-origin surface.
		var view = ~&6504254477&~
		var shotW = 954
		var shotH = 1696
		if (!bounds || !view || !isFinite(view.width) || Number(view.width) <= 0) {
			paperAgentCropMode = "invalid-selection"
			console.log("paper-agent crop unavailable", "bounds=" + (!!bounds), "view=" + (!!view))
			return null
		}

		var xOrigin = Number(view.width) / 2 + Number(view.x || 0)
		var x0 = xOrigin + Number(bounds.x)
		var y0 = Number(bounds.y)
		var x1 = x0 + Number(bounds.width)
		var y1 = y0 + Number(bounds.height)

		// rm-shot on Chiappa exposes Xochitl's 954x1696 RGB565 surface. Keep the
		// padding in physical pixels after the scene transform.
		var padX = 48
		var padY = 36
		if (!isFinite(x0) || !isFinite(y0) || !isFinite(x1) || !isFinite(y1)
				|| x1 <= 0 || y1 <= 0 || x0 >= shotW || y0 >= shotH
				|| x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) {
			paperAgentCropMode = "outside-framebuffer"
			console.log("paper-agent crop outside framebuffer", [x0, y0, x1, y1].join(","))
			return null
		}
		var left = Math.max(0, Math.floor(x0 - padX))
		var top = Math.max(0, Math.floor(y0 - padY))
		var right = Math.min(shotW, Math.ceil(x1 + padX))
		var bottom = Math.min(shotH, Math.ceil(y1 + padY))
		if (right - left < 32 || bottom - top < 32) {
			paperAgentCropMode = "too-small"
			console.log("paper-agent crop too small", [left, top, right, bottom].join(","))
			return null

		var controller = view.controller || null
		var pageBounds = controller ? (controller.paperNoteBounds || controller.boundingRect || null) : null

			"bounds=" + [bounds.x, bounds.y, bounds.width, bounds.height].join(","),
			"pageBounds=" + (pageBounds ? [pageBounds.x, pageBounds.y, pageBounds.width, pageBounds.height].join(",") : "null"),
			"view=" + [view.width, view.height, view.x, view.y].join(","),
			"translatedBounds=" + [x0, y0, x1, y1].join(","),

	function paperAgentNativePlacement(bounds) {
		var view = ~&6504254477&~
		var shotW = 954
		var shotH = 1696
		if (!bounds || !view || !isFinite(view.width) || Number(view.width) <= 0)
			return null

		// above only when necessary. Scale that policy to Chiappa's Xochitl
		// surface and keep clear of the top toolbar and screen edges.
		var xOrigin = Number(view.width) / 2 + Number(view.x || 0)
		var selX = xOrigin + Number(bounds.x)
		var selY = Number(bounds.y)
		var selW = Number(bounds.width)
		var selH = Number(bounds.height)
		if (!isFinite(selX) || !isFinite(selY) || !isFinite(selW) || !isFinite(selH)
				|| selW <= 0 || selH <= 0)
			return null

		var sideMargin = 50
		var topMargin = 150
		var bottomMargin = 50
		var gap = 32
		var minHeight = 260
		var width = Math.round(Math.max(480, Math.min(shotW - sideMargin * 2, selW * 1.5)))
		var x = Math.round(Math.max(sideMargin, Math.min(shotW - sideMargin - width, selX)))
		var belowY = Math.round(selY + selH + gap)
		var belowHeight = shotH - bottomMargin - belowY
		var aboveHeight = Math.round(selY - gap - topMargin)
		var y
		var height
		if (belowHeight >= minHeight || belowHeight >= aboveHeight) {
			y = Math.max(topMargin, belowY)
			height = shotH - bottomMargin - y
		} else {
			y = topMargin
			height = aboveHeight
		}
		if (height < 96) return null
		height = Math.round(height)
		var placement = { x: x, y: Math.round(y), width: width, height: height }
		console.log("paper-agent native placement",
			"selection=" + [selX, selY, selW, selH].join(","),
			"placement=" + [placement.x, placement.y, placement.width, placement.height].join(","))

	// Xochitl 3.27's native image API accepts a scene-space drop point. Keep
	// this separate from paperAgentNativePlacement(), which is deliberately in
	// framebuffer coordinates for virtual-Marker stroke injection.
	function paperAgentRememberImageRequest(requestId, bounds) {
		var view = ~&6504254477&~
		var controller = view ? (view.controller || null) : null
		if (!controller || !bounds) return false
		var paper = controller.paperNoteBounds || controller.boundingRect || null
		var next = paperAgentPendingImageRequests

			pageId: view.pageId !== undefined ? String(view.pageId) : "",
			bounds: {

				width: Number(bounds.width), height: Number(bounds.height)

			paper: paper ? {
				x: Number(paper.x), y: Number(paper.y),
				width: Number(paper.width), height: Number(paper.height)
			} : null
		}
		paperAgentPendingImageRequests = next
		console.log("paper-agent remembered native image target", requestId,
			bounds.x, bounds.y, bounds.width, bounds.height)

	}

	function paperAgentImagePoint(pending, imageWidth, imageHeight) {
		var bounds = pending.bounds
		var paper = pending.paper

		var halfWidth = imageWidth / 2
		var halfHeight = imageHeight / 2
		var x = bounds.x + bounds.width / 2
		var below = bounds.y + bounds.height + gap + halfHeight
		var above = bounds.y - gap - halfHeight

			var top = paper.y + 24 + halfHeight
			var bottom = paper.y + paper.height - 24 - halfHeight

			else y = Math.max(top, Math.min(bottom, below))

	function paperAgentForgetImageRequest(requestId) {
		var key = String(requestId)
		if (!paperAgentPendingImageRequests[key]) return
		var next = paperAgentPendingImageRequests
		delete next[key]
		paperAgentPendingImageRequests = next
	}

	function paperAgentRemoveImageArtifact(requestId) {
		var filePath = "/home/root/paper-agent/native/artifacts/" + String(requestId) + ".png"
		try {
			paperAgentCommandExecutor.executeCommand("/bin/rm", ["-f", filePath])
		} catch (error) {
			console.log("paper-agent image artifact cleanup failed", String(error))
		}
	}

	XoviMessageBroker {
		id: paperAgentNativeImageBroker
		listeningFor: ["paper-agent$image", "paper-agent$request"]
		function onSignalReceived(signal, message) {
			var fields = String(message).split(",")
			var requestId = fields[0]
			if (!/^[0-9]{10,20}$/.test(requestId)) return
			if (signal === "paper-agent$request") {
				if (fields.length === 2 && (fields[1] === "done" || fields[1] === "error"))
					paperAgentForgetImageRequest(requestId)
				return
			}
			if (signal !== "paper-agent$image" || fields.length !== 3
					|| !/^[0-9]{2,4}$/.test(fields[1]) || !/^[0-9]{2,4}$/.test(fields[2])) return
			var imageWidth = Number(fields[1])
			var imageHeight = Number(fields[2])
			if (imageWidth < 32 || imageHeight < 32 || imageWidth > 800 || imageHeight > 800) {
				console.log("paper-agent rejected unsafe image dimensions", requestId,
					imageWidth, imageHeight)
				paperAgentRemoveImageArtifact(requestId)
				paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "error")

			}
			var pending = paperAgentPendingImageRequests[requestId]
			if (!pending || !pending.controller || !pending.bounds) {
				console.log("paper-agent rejected image for stale page", requestId)
				paperAgentRemoveImageArtifact(requestId)
				paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "error")
				return
			}
			var currentView = ~&6504254477&~
			if (!currentView || currentView.controller !== pending.controller
					|| (pending.pageId && String(currentView.pageId) !== pending.pageId)) {
				console.log("paper-agent rejected image after page changed", requestId)
				paperAgentRemoveImageArtifact(requestId)
				paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "error")
				return
			}
			var insert = pending.controller["insertImageFileAsSceneItem"]
			if (typeof insert !== "function") {
				console.log("paper-agent native image API unavailable")
				paperAgentRemoveImageArtifact(requestId)
				paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "error")
				return
			}
			try {
				var insertionPoint = paperAgentImagePoint(pending, imageWidth, imageHeight)
				paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "inserting")
				var filePath = "/home/root/paper-agent/native/artifacts/" + requestId + ".png"
				var fileUrl = Qt.resolvedUrl("file://" + filePath)

				// Xochitl reads the local file synchronously into a QImage before
				// scheduling its Scene update, so the source artifact is no longer
				// referenced after this call returns.
				paperAgentRemoveImageArtifact(requestId)
				console.log("paper-agent scheduled native image insertion", requestId,
					insertionPoint.x, insertionPoint.y, imageWidth, imageHeight)
			} catch (error) {
				console.log("paper-agent native image insertion failed", String(error))
				paperAgentRemoveImageArtifact(requestId)
				paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "error")
			}
		}
	}

	function paperAgentOpenNativeSelection(action, crop, placement, bounds) {
		paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "thinking")
		if ((action !== "ai" && action !== "beautify") || !crop || !placement) {
			console.log("paper-agent native capture cancelled", paperAgentCropMode)
			paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "error")
			return false
		}
		var requestId = (new Date()).getTime()
		var shotPath = "/home/root/paper-agent/selection/native-selection-" + requestId + ".png"
		var args = shotPath + ",180,0," + crop.join(",")
		var result = paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot", args)
		console.log("paper-agent native capture", result, args)
		if (result !== "success") {
			paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "error")
			return false

		// transient selection scene. Arguments are passed directly without a

				 "/home/root/paper-agent/native/native-selection-write.sh",
				 action, shotPath, String(placement.x), String(placement.y),
				 String(placement.width), String(placement.height)])
			console.log("paper-agent native write scheduled", unit, output)
			return true
		} catch (error) {
			paperAgentForgetImageRequest(stamp)
			console.log("paper-agent native write schedule failed", String(error))
			paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$status", "error")
			return false

		~&6504254477&~.~&7282468819357443632&~(function () {
			paperAgentOpenNativeSelection(action, crop, placement, bounds)
			~&6504254477&~.~&12148339614529610933&~()

			// persistent Toolbar listener to restore the primary pen immediately;
			// the worker repeats this just before native ink as a race guard.
			paperAgentScreenshotBroker.sendSimpleSignal("paper-agent$tool", "primary")
		})
	}

	onPaperAgentBeautifySelection: paperAgentRunSelection("beautify")

; Restore the primary pen through Xochitl's own toolbar model. This is adapted
; from the 3.27 gestik implementation in alefaraci/xovi-qmd-extensions, which
; uses selectPen("primary") plus documentViewTools.activeTool instead of a
; device-specific synthetic tap.

	TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]
		LOCATE AFTER ALL

		XoviMessageBroker {
			id: paperAgentToolBroker
			listeningFor: ["paper-agent$tool"]
			function onSignalReceived(signal, message) {
				if (signal !== "paper-agent$tool" || message !== "primary") return
				try {
					~&6504254477&~.~&254547531013823564&~("primary")
					~&7842069035455457876&~.~&8399230650759060099&~ = "primary"
					var children = ~&8400129135001204805&~.~&7712883416119442&~
					var primary = null
					for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
						var item = children[i].~&6503936152&~
						if (!item || item.~&7713561545874130&~ === undefined) continue
						if (item.~&8399878573055752961&~ === "primaryPenMenu") primary = item
						else {
							item.~&7713561545874130&~ = false
							if (item.~&14458508249923637586&~ !== undefined)
								item.~&14458508249923637586&~ = false
						}
					}
					if (primary) {
						~&6504254477&~.~&16536305558369217168&~ = primary
						primary.~&7713561545874130&~ = true
					}
					console.log("paper-agent restored primary pen")
				} catch (error) {
					console.log("paper-agent primary pen restore failed", String(error))
				}
			}
		}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Use Xochitl's native NotificationBar rather than an ordinary animated QML
; Rectangle. The native component owns its e-paper refresh path and stays at
; the bottom of MainView, clear of the document toolbar.
AFFECT [[2328484894988065446]]
	IMPORT [[233700934949963.233693781272506]] [[180922.180921]]
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker [[180923.180921]]
	TRAVERSE [[8397788359424131273]]#[[6504254477]] > [[8397993708429497603]]#[[7713531976371484]]
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
		~&425121728314878811&~.~&11119534664549952261&~ {
			id: paperAgentStatusBar
			property string paperAgentState: "idle"
			~&233721384511543&~.~&6504027668&~: parent.left
			~&233721384511543&~.~&214640173127&~: parent.right
			~&233721384511543&~.~&7082507142622&~: parent.bottom
			visible: paperAgentState !== "idle"
			z: 100000
			~&6504337259&~: ~&254477762679831355&~.~&11119534664549952261&~.~&233740920352621&~

			function paperAgentShowState(nextState) {
				console.log("paper-agent native notification", nextState)
				// Image insertion happens in QML after the local oracle has already
				// delivered its artifact. Keep a native-insertion failure sticky so
				// the worker's later transport-level `done` cannot hide it.
				if (paperAgentState === "error" && nextState === "done") return
				paperAgentState = nextState
				if (nextState === "thinking" || nextState === "generating_image"
						|| nextState === "inserting") {
					paperAgentDeadline.restart()
					paperAgentResultTimer.stop()
				} else {
					paperAgentDeadline.stop()
					paperAgentResultTimer.interval = nextState === "done" ? 1400 : 4500
					paperAgentResultTimer.restart()
				}
			}

			XoviMessageBroker {
				id: paperAgentStatusBroker
				listeningFor: ["paper-agent$status"]
				function onSignalReceived(signal, message) {
					if (signal !== "paper-agent$status") return
					if (message === "thinking" || message === "generating_image"
							|| message === "inserting" || message === "done" || message === "error")
						paperAgentStatusBar.paperAgentShowState(message)
				}
			}

			Timer {
				id: paperAgentDeadline
				interval: 325000
				onTriggered: paperAgentStatusBar.paperAgentShowState("error")
			}
			Timer {
				id: paperAgentResultTimer
				onTriggered: paperAgentStatusBar.paperAgentState = "idle"
			}

			~&425121728314878811&~.~&11119534664549952261&~.~&233695222288046&~ {
				~&6504315758&~: paperAgentStatusBar.paperAgentState === "thinking"
					? "Paper Agent is thinking..."
					: paperAgentStatusBar.paperAgentState === "generating_image"
						? "Paper Agent is creating an image..."
						: paperAgentStatusBar.paperAgentState === "inserting"
							? "Paper Agent is adding the image..."
					: paperAgentStatusBar.paperAgentState === "done"
								? "Paper Agent finished"
								: "Paper Agent failed"
				~&7081629735527&~.~&254529418434902000&~: true
				~&7081629735527&~.~&8399743405844438450&~: ~&425121728314878811&~.~&7082020628281&~.~&233740248806464&~.~&214641496386&~
				~&7081629735527&~.~&499747351624466981&~: ~&425121728314878811&~.~&7082020628281&~.~&233740248806464&~.~&214641496386&~
			}
		}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
